title: Building Socio-culturally Inclusive Stereotype Resources with Community Engagement
reasoning: The paper benchmarks stereotypes related to religious identity in India, specifically identifying religion as a core axis of disparity. It collects and evaluates stereotypes for identities including Hindu, Muslim, Jain, Sikh, Christian, and Buddhist, and benchmarks several language models (BART, RoBERTa, XLNET, and ELECTRA) on their performance in religious stereotype evaluation tasks.
